summary: Customer service platform organized around people rather than tickets, for enterprise brands.
access_note: No self-serve signup seen (Get a demo); API tokens are created by an admin for a user with the API User permission, used as HTTP Basic.
blocker_note: Only existing Gladly customers (enterprise sales) have an organization and tokens; no trial or sandbox signup found.
notes: No Gladly-published MCP found; the official MCP registry lists third-party Gladly servers (usefulapi.io, cotlet.dev), usage unverified. Gladly docs say a sandbox at {organization}.gladly.qa is enabled for the organization (customers only). No self-serve signup seen.

evidence.quote: To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
Find customers, read conversations, items and tasks; add internal notes in Gladly.
Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication

review.reason: MCP registry lists third-party Gladly servers (dev.cotlet/gladly, io.usefulapi/gladly); none are Gladly-published, so not official, but not none.
